question:
Consider the following statements regarding the sex-ratio in India as per Census 2011:
1. The sex-ratio in Rajasthan was lower than the national average.
2. The sex-ratio in all districts of Rajasthan was less than 1000.
3. The sex-ratio in urban areas of all districts of Rajasthan was less than 1000, except for Dhaulpur District.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Statement (i) is correct because India's sex-ratio in 2011 was 943, while Rajasthan's was 928. Statement (iii) is incorrect as the text states that the sex-ratio in urban areas of all districts of Rajasthan, including Dhaulpur, was less than 1000, contradicting the exception mentioned.
question_hi:

उपरोक्त में से कौन सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?
explanation_hi: कथन (i) सही है क्योंकि 2011 में भारत का लिंगानुपात 943 था, जबकि राजस्थान का 928 था। कथन (iii) गलत है क्योंकि पाठ में कहा गया है कि धौलपुर सहित राजस्थान के सभी जिलों के शहरी क्षेत्रों में लिंगानुपात 1000 से कम था, जो उल्लिखित अपवाद का खंडन करता है।
